data.exact_reserve_text:
Significant movements in year 2021 for net ultimate claims provisions created at previous year end and relating to accident years up to year 2020 (positive values show increases in provisions):
2021 2020
GBP '000 GBP '000
Accident and health (2,240) 1,734 
Fire & other damage to property (4,025) (4,552)
Third party liability (9,833) 1,796
Property Reinsurance (2,119) (5,526)
Liability Reinsurance 4,016 (1,400)
While the main constituents of the liability reinsurance reserve increased (concussion) or remained largely unaltered (casualty catastrophe), several other areas produced reduced concern allowing this overall positive result. The movements in all other classes and the overall pattern are consistent with a prudent reserving approach.

prior_year_events.event_name: Opioid / latent liability concerns and regulatory attention
prior_year_events.impact_description: Regulators highlighted potential latent US casualty exposures (opioids etc). Syndicate maintained a cautious reserving stance and a separate reserve was held in Solvency II to anticipate opioid claims; model for latent exposures developed in 2016 and used thereafter.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded net favourable prior-year reserve development for accident years up to 2020, driven primarily by favourable claims development and IBNR recalibration across a number of classes (notably Accident & Health, Property and Third Party Liability). The gross claims development triangle indicates an aggregate release of approximately GBP 10.16m (around 3.8% of opening gross claims outstanding). The syndicate continues to hold conservative margins above actuarial best estimates to allow for long-tail US liability latent exposures and regulatory concerns such as opioids and social inflation.
raw_causal_phrases: reduction in the estimate of 2018 and prior years' liability reserves as a result of favourable claims developments in 2021
the syndicate adopts an approach to claims reserving that is above the actuary's best estimate, primarily to allow for the future emergence of latent losses on its long tail US liability business
favourable development of paid and incurred claims during 2021

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (claims development table) because the narrative/movement note in the reserves section reports net movements by class. The triangle excludes the aggregated '2011 and prior' column (per report) and that aggregate was omitted per rules. Some reserve movement discussion in the notes is presented net of reinsurance; where only net figures were available by class those have been reported in 'lob_movements' with lower confidence. RITC items were considered; no material distortion of the triangle by RITC at 2021 year-end was identified for the included UW columns.
